name: tests-50pct-buffalo-renderer-aware-conditional-6fed
instr:
Buffalo cannot currently reuse completed renderer-aware HTTP representations across equivalent GET and HEAD requests. Add optional, application-scoped caching without changing rendering semantics. Without configuration, rendering stays uncached.

Keys must cover request-visible inputs and actual renderer output dependencies. JSON and XML identities track encodable values; XML replay preserves its declaration, indentation, content type, and failure behavior. String and template identities track data, helpers, engines, localized files, layouts, metadata, and dependency changes. Cache only identifiable downloads without consuming them. Func bypasses reuse unless KeyedFunc provides a stable identity.

Only GET and HEAD rendering is eligible. Other methods and renderers run normally; cached conditional GETs skip rendering. Replay status, safe headers, body, and Response accounting, suppressing HEAD bodies. Coordinate equivalent concurrent misses so they render once. Renderer, cache, session, or flash failures publish nothing, commit no successful partial response, release waiters, and permit retry. Existing Renderer implementations remain compatible; CacheableRenderer opts in. MemoryRepresentationCache provides isolated immutable storage.

An eligible JSON GET publishes once; an equivalent request returns identical HTTP output without encoding again. Concurrent requests after a localized template dependency changes publish one fresh complete representation for that dependency set.
